identity.title: Powered Industrial Truck Pre-Shift Inspection Log — Forklift FL-2 (Toyota 8FGU25), September 2026, Portland Warehouse

scan.summary: This is the pre-shift inspection log for forklift FL-2 at the Portland warehouse, recording daily checklist results and operator initials through September 17, 2026. It is a company record, not a standard to be met — what matters is whether entries are complete, current, and show that defects were corrected before the truck was put back in service.
scan.freshness_note: Log runs through Sep 17, 2026; today is Sep 27, 2026, so at least eight working days (Sep 18–25, excluding a weekend) of entries are not shown or do not exist in this excerpt — ask whether a continuation page exists.

gaps.title: Missing entries for Sep 3 and Sep 4, 2026
gaps.description: The log has no rows for Sep 3 or Sep 4, 2026, both weekdays falling between logged entries on Sep 2 and Sep 7. Pre-shift inspection is required before each shift the truck is used.
gaps.fix: Confirm whether the truck was operated on Sep 3–4; if so, obtain or reconstruct the missing inspection records and note why they were not completed at the time.
gaps.locator: table rows between Sep 2 and Sep 7 entries

gaps.title: Horn defect on Sep 9 with no documented repair
gaps.description: The Sep 9 entry marks the horn defective ("X") with the note "Horn not working," and the standard requires the truck not be used until the defect is corrected, yet the next entry (Sep 10) simply shows the horn as OK with no repair record, work order, or out-of-service notation in between.
gaps.fix: Add a maintenance/repair record showing what was done to the horn between Sep 9 and Sep 10, and confirm the truck was taken out of service until repaired.

facts.value: Horn marked defective (X) on Sep 9, 2026, with note 'Horn not working'; horn shown OK again on Sep 10 with no repair entry in between
facts.locator: Sep 9 row, Horn column and Notes column
facts.affects: Whether the forklift was properly taken out of service and repaired before further use, per 29 CFR 1910.178(q)(7)

facts.value: No log entries exist for Sep 3 or Sep 4, 2026, both weekdays between the Sep 2 and Sep 7 entries
facts.affects: Whether pre-shift inspections were performed on those days as required

scan.confidence_notes: High confidence on what is physically shown in the log (dates, checkmarks, notes) since it is read directly from the table. The two gaps here are the same underlying findings already open in the company's file (horn defect and Sep 3–4 gap), so they are linked rather than treated as new. Not certain whether a continuation page beyond Sep 17 exists or whether the horn was actually repaired but simply undocumented — this is inferred as a documentation gap, not proof the repair never happened.
